description.value: A purpose-built, fully licensed luxury waterfront B&B situated on the shores of the Esquimalt Lagoon Migratory Bird Sanctuary in Colwood, on the western beaches of greater Victoria. The property offers three self-contained private-entrance studio suites on the second floor, each with individual climate control, and sits on an ocean lagoon with a private dock, kayaks, and canoes available to guests. The website features dedicated pages for arriving by bicycle and an on-site EV charging station, signaling a cyclist- and adventure-traveller-aware operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is an active, licensed luxury B&B on Esquimalt Lagoon in Colwood near Victoria, operating since 1997 and rebuilt in 2006. The navigation menu includes a dedicated 'Arrive by Bicycle' page and an 'EV Charging Station' page, strongly suggesting cyclist-aware amenities, but the content of those specific subpages was not captured in the prefetch so no details about bike storage or e-bike charging can be confirmed. Contact details (phone, partial address) are sourced from the website since the OSM record contains no tags at all.
